entities.name: Maria Renata Saenger von Mossau
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Renata Singer or Saenger von Mossau was a Bavarian nun executed for heresy, witchcraft, apostasy and satanism, one of the last people executed for these charges in Germany and Europe.
